function.name: x_search
function.description:
Search X (Twitter) posts, threads, and profiles using xAI's native X Search.

xAI has real-time, privileged access to all of X's data (Elon Musk owns both
companies). This tool is fundamentally different from web scraping — Grok
runs the search server-side with full fidelity to actual post content,
engagement, and recency.

Use this tool to:
- Find recent tweets on any topic
- Search specific users' posts (allowed_x_handles)
- Research what's being said about a person, company, or event on X
- Analyze media attached to posts (images, videos)
- Filter by date range

Returns the answer synthesized by Grok with direct citation links to posts.

allowed_x_handles.description: Only include posts from these X handles (max 10, without @). Mutually exclusive with excluded_x_handles.

enable_image_understanding.description: Whether to analyze images attached to X posts. Default false.

enable_video_understanding.description: Whether to analyze videos attached to X posts. Default false.

excluded_x_handles.description: Exclude posts from these X handles (max 10, without @). Mutually exclusive with allowed_x_handles.

from_date.description: Start date for results in YYYY-MM-DD format.

query.description: What to search for on X. Can be a topic, hashtag, question, or statement.

to_date.description: End date for results in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: xai_web_search
function.description:
Search the web in real-time using xAI's (Grok's) built-in web search.

Grok browses the live web server-side — fetching pages, reading content, and
synthesizing an answer with source citations. Unlike static search engines,
Grok can follow links and read full page content.

Optionally filter to or exclude specific domains (max 5 each).

Returns Grok's synthesized answer plus citation URLs. Use for current events,
documentation, research — anything that benefits from live web access.

allowed_domains.description: Only include results from these domains (max 5, e.g. ["github.com"]). Mutually exclusive with excluded_domains.

excluded_domains.description: Exclude results from these domains (max 5). Mutually exclusive with allowed_domains.
